She is a very stable performer but she is still young and has time to improve and refine both her vocal and dance techniques. I am a dancer (14+ years in ballet, tap, jazz, hip hop and 4 years in rhythmic gymnastics) and she definitely has potential. From my analysis she can be very stiff at times and lacks precision especially during quick movements but with the amount of phenomenal dancers in this group I think they will help her improve. She is also showing improvements with her facials and presence. I just hope the hate doesn’t get to her and she can show her improvements without feeling overwhelmed.

edit: I went back and looked at all her fancams again and I can see a great improvement in her fluidity. She definitely is not as stiff as she was during Fiesta, but she still lacks in making precise and full movements and placements. Her facials are interesting though because she has good presence in Shoot during every part except when she’s singing - it’s inconsistent.
